title: Beyond the 956: Former YouTuber EDP445 arrested in Las Vegas on felony sex-crime charges
excerpt: Bryant Moreland, known online as former YouTuber EDP445, was arrested in the Las Vegas area on November 4 and is expected to be extradited to Kern County, California, to face four felony charges stemming from a 2021 sting operation. He is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Bryant Moreland, known online as former YouTuber EDP445, was arrested in the Las Vegas area on November 4, according to WorldStar and news reports.

The Kern County District Attorney's Office filed four felony charges against Moreland on November 2, reports said. The charges are attempted lewd or lascivious acts with a child under 14, meeting a minor for lewd purposes, contacting a minor with intent to commit a sexual offense, and distributing or showing pornography to a minor. Moreland was taken into custody with assistance from the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department and is expected to be extradited to Kern County, California, to face the charges.

The charges stem from a 2021 sting operation in Bakersfield, California, involving a person Moreland allegedly believed to be a minor. Prosecutors reopened the investigation after statements Moreland made in the documentary "The Sick Mind of EDP445," reports said.

The person at the center of the 2021 operation has not been publicly named in the reports reviewed, and no victim is named here. The charges are allegations at this stage, and Moreland is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Update — November 6, 2026

Moreland is expected to appear for a hearing in Las Vegas on Monday, November 9, at which point he will likely be extradited to Kern County, California, to face the four felony charges, according to Oxygen, citing the Kern County District Attorney's Office. He has not yet been arraigned or entered a plea. The charges remain allegations at this stage, and Moreland is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Update — November 9, 2026

Moreland appeared in Las Vegas Justice Court on Monday, November 9, and signed a waiver of extradition, clearing the way for his transfer to Kern County, California, to face the four felony charges, according to The Las Vegas Focal. California authorities have 30 days to arrange the transfer, and an arraignment will be scheduled after he arrives in Kern County. Moreland remains in custody in Nevada pending transfer. He has not entered a plea. The charges remain allegations at this stage, and Moreland is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post, https://www.instagram.com/p/DfVmSNLD9qe/; HotNewHipHop, reporting the arrest, charges and extradition.

Sources: Oxygen — “YouTuber EDP445 Arrested After Admitting in Documentary He Tried to Have Sex With a 13-Year-Old” (Nov. 5, 2026); USA TODAY — “Popular YouTuber charged with sex crimes after shocking documentary” (Nov. 5, 2026).

Sources: The Las Vegas Focal — “Ex-YouTuber Bryant Moreland Waives Extradition to California on Child Sex Crime Charges” (November 9, 2026).
